svg.aria-label: Kortex-Shield — A web application firewall built to a checkable standard: evaluation harness with frozen attack and benign corpora; baselines measured against OWASP CRS; proxy engine built on Coraza. Status: public repo. 1,054 attack samples, 4 attack families, 2 engines compared.
